title: Me prestás
setting: Chino catches you on the pavement on the fifteenth. He has never asked you for anything before.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.en: Ideay, you. Have you got any spare cash?

options.feedback: Depende buys you the time to hear it, and contame says you are willing to listen.
Straight to the number. It works, but you have skipped the part where he explains.
A door closed before he even said what for. He will not ask twice, about anything.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Es para la medicina de mi mamá. Te lo pago el treinta.
steps.en: It is for my mother's medicine. I will pay you back on the thirtieth.

options.es: Está bien. ¿Cuánto es lo que falta?
options.en: All right. How much is missing?
options.feedback: You accepted before asking the amount. That order matters more here than the number does.

options.en: And you will definitely pay me back?
options.feedback: Fair to ask, and it tells him you are counting. That is not how it is done between two of you.
A rule where a person was standing. He will hear the rule and remember the person.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.en: Five hundred. I have the rest.

options.es: Aquí están. Y no andés apurado con eso.
options.en: Here they are. And do not be in a rush about it.
options.feedback: Handed over and the pressure taken off in the same breath. That is what makes it a favour and not a loan.

options.en: Here you are. The thirtieth then.
options.feedback: Fine, and it names the date. A shade more like a contract than it needs to be.

options.en: I will give you three hundred only.
options.feedback: Half a favour reads as half trust. Either do it or say you cannot.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.en: You are all right, you really are.

options.en: That is what we are here for.
options.feedback: The exact answer. It refuses the thanks and keeps the two of you level.
Correct and warm enough. It answers the words rather than what he meant.

options.es: Ya sabés que me lo tenés que pagar.
options.en: You know you have to pay me back.
options.feedback: He just said something large. Answering it with the debt is the coldest thing available.
